1:1: Lk 1:1–15, 57–68, 76, 80: This passage is read on June 24, the Feast of the Birth of John the Baptist.
1:5: This passage is read on September 23, the Feast of the Conception of John the Baptist.
1:24: Mary. This passage is read on March 25, the Feast of the Annunciation of the Virgin
2:1: Christ. This passage is read on December 24, the Eve of the Nativity of Our Lord Jesus
2:20: Lk 2:20, 21, 40–52: This passage is read on January 1, the Feast of the Circumcision of Christ.
2:22: This passage is read on February 2, the Feast of the Presentation of the Lord in the Temple.
3:1: This passage is read on the Eve of the Feast of the Baptism of Christ (Theophany).
4:16: This passage is read on September 1, the beginning of the Ecclesiastical New Year.
4:22: This passage is read on July 20, the Feast of the Prophet Elias.
